<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Claude Fable 5.1 is Anthropic&#x27;s latest Mythos-class model and replaces <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/models/claude-fable-5">Fable 5</a>. It is built for long-running, complex, and asynchronous coding and knowledge work. Input and output rates match Fable 5. Prompt-cache reads are 75% cheaper.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="enabling-fable-51"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#enabling-fable-51" data-heading-base-id="enabling-fable-51" aria-label="Copy link to enabling-fable-51"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Enabling Fable 5.1</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Fable 5.1 has the same privacy considerations as other Fable models because of how Anthropic handles data retention. If Privacy Mode is enabled for your account, team, or organization, you will need to approve Fable 5.1&#x27;s Data Retention Policy in the Cursor Dashboard before you can use the model. You can view the policy in the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/dashboard/restricted_models/claude-fable-5-1" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Cursor Dashboard</a>.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">For Teams accounts, approving the model policy applies to the entire Team.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">For Enterprise accounts, model availability is approved at the Organization level but continues to be controlled at the team and group level in the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/enterprise/model-and-integration-management#model-access-control">Model Access controls</a>.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Head to <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/dashboard/restricted_models/claude-fable-5-1" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Team Settings</a> to enable Fable 5.1 for your Team, Organization, or account.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="strengths"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#strengths" data-heading-base-id="strengths" aria-label="Copy link to strengths"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Strengths</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Cleaner communication than Fable 5 on long-running agent sessions.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Built for autonomous, multi-step work. It holds intent across long sessions and drives tasks to completion with fewer check-ins.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Deep reasoning. A thinking variant is available for problems that reward extra deliberation.</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="limitations"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#limitations" data-heading-base-id="limitations" aria-label="Copy link to limitations"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Limitations</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Same Anthropic data-retention opt-in as other Fable models. Privacy Mode and Enterprise customers need admin approval before use.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Input and output rates stay at about twice <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/models/claude-opus-5">Claude Opus 5</a>.</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="data-retention"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#data-retention" data-heading-base-id="data-retention" aria-label="Copy link to data-retention"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Data retention</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Anthropic&#x27;s policy for Fable models is described in detail <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://trust.anthropic.com/resources?s=7ksqkied5hn0pocsj206m&amp;name=%5Banthropic%5D-security-and-privacy-design-of-anthropic-data-retention-and-review" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">here</a> and as follows:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Retained customer data is being deleted after 30 days, automatically and permanently, unless subject to a safety investigation or legal hold</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Retained customer data is not readable by any person by default</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Retained enterprise data is not being used to train Claude</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Retained customer data is not being shared with other customers</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Enabling and using Fable 5.1 does not change your Privacy Mode settings or Cursor&#x27;s own retention of your data.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Because of how Fable 5.1 handles data, it is off by default in every Team that has Cursor <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/enterprise/privacy-and-data-governance">Privacy Mode</a> enabled <em>and</em> for every Enterprise customer, regardless of Cursor Privacy Mode settings.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Fable 5.1 is on by default for every individual customer or Team account for which Cursor Privacy Mode is disabled.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">For customers on the Enterprise plan or with Cursor Privacy Mode enabled, it requires explicit opt-in and the model won&#x27;t be available until an admin explicitly enables it. Here&#x27;s what to know before enabling it:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Data retention.</strong> When Fable 5.1 is used, regardless of your Cursor <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/enterprise/privacy-and-data-governance">Privacy Mode</a> settings, Anthropic stores agent input and output data to support automated and human harm-prevention processes. This data is not used to train or improve Anthropic&#x27;s models or products.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Opt-in is team-wide.</strong> Enabling Fable 5.1 requires opting in to Anthropic&#x27;s data retention terms, and this applies to your entire team. Enterprise admins can restrict which user groups are able to use the model with <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/enterprise/model-and-integration-management#model-access-control">model access control</a>.</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="automatic-fallback-to-opus"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#automatic-fallback-to-opus" data-heading-base-id="automatic-fallback-to-opus" aria-label="Copy link to automatic-fallback-to-opus"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Automatic fallback to Opus</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Fable 5.1 runs with tight security guardrails. When a request trips one of those guardrails, Cursor routes it to Claude Opus automatically so your work continues without an error. You don&#x27;t need to retry or switch models yourself.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="tools"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#tools" data-heading-base-id="tools" aria-label="Copy link to tools"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Tools</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Fable 5.1 has access to all agent tools when used with Cursor including:</p>

<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Fable 5.1 bills at $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens, the same as Fable 5. Prompt-cache reads are $0.25 per million tokens, 75% below Fable 5&#x27;s $1.00 cache-read rate. Cache writes stay at $12.50 per million tokens.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Fable 5.1 supports a thinking variant for deeper reasoning. We recommend the high thinking variant for the strongest results.</p></div><div class="mt-12 flex items-center gap-4 border-t border-border pt-6"><div class="relative"><button <p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Claude Fable 5.1 is Anthropic&#x27;s latest Mythos-class model and replaces <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/models/claude-fable-5">Fable 5</a>. It is built for long-running, complex, and asynchronous coding and knowledge work. Input and output rates match Fable 5. Prompt-cache reads are 75% cheaper.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="enabling-fable-51"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#enabling-fable-51" data-heading-base-id="enabling-fable-51" aria-label="Copy link to enabling-fable-51"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Enabling Fable 5.1</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Fable 5.1 has the same privacy considerations as other Fable models because of how Anthropic handles data retention. If Privacy Mode is enabled for your account, team, or organization, you will need to approve Fable 5.1&#x27;s Data Retention Policy in the Cursor Dashboard before you can use the model. You can view the policy in the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/dashboard/restricted_models/claude-fable-5-1" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Cursor Dashboard</a>.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">For Teams accounts, approving the model policy applies to the entire Team.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">For Enterprise accounts, model availability is approved at the Organization level but continues to be controlled at the team and group level in the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/enterprise/model-and-integration-management#model-access-control">Model Access controls</a>.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Head to <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/dashboard/restricted_models/claude-fable-5-1" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Team Settings</a> to enable Fable 5.1 for your Team, Organization, or account.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="strengths"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#strengths" data-heading-base-id="strengths" aria-label="Copy link to strengths"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Strengths</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Cleaner communication than Fable 5 on long-running agent sessions.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Built for autonomous, multi-step work. It holds intent across long sessions and drives tasks to completion with fewer check-ins.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Deep reasoning. A thinking variant is available for problems that reward extra deliberation.</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="limitations"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#limitations" data-heading-base-id="limitations" aria-label="Copy link to limitations"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Limitations</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Same Anthropic data-retention opt-in as other Fable models. Privacy Mode and Enterprise customers need admin approval before use.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Input and output rates stay at about twice <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/models/claude-opus-5">Claude Opus 5</a>.</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="data-retention"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#data-retention" data-heading-base-id="data-retention" aria-label="Copy link to data-retention"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Data retention</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Anthropic&#x27;s policy for Fable models is described in detail <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://trust.anthropic.com/resources?s=7ksqkied5hn0pocsj206m&amp;name=%5Banthropic%5D-security-and-privacy-design-of-anthropic-data-retention-and-review" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">here</a> and as follows:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Retained customer data is being deleted after 30 days, automatically and permanently, unless subject to a safety investigation or legal hold</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Retained customer data is not readable by any person by default</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Retained enterprise data is not being used to train Claude</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Retained customer data is not being shared with other customers</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Enabling and using Fable 5.1 does not change your Privacy Mode settings or Cursor&#x27;s own retention of your data.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Because of how Fable 5.1 handles data, it is off by default in every Team that has Cursor <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/enterprise/privacy-and-data-governance">Privacy Mode</a> enabled <em>and</em> for every Enterprise customer, regardless of Cursor Privacy Mode settings.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Fable 5.1 is on by default for every individual customer or Team account for which Cursor Privacy Mode is disabled.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">For customers on the Enterprise plan or with Cursor Privacy Mode enabled, it requires explicit opt-in and the model won&#x27;t be available until an admin explicitly enables it. Here&#x27;s what to know before enabling it:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Data retention.</strong> When Fable 5.1 is used, regardless of your Cursor <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/enterprise/privacy-and-data-governance">Privacy Mode</a> settings, Anthropic stores agent input and output data to support automated and human harm-prevention processes. This data is not used to train or improve Anthropic&#x27;s models or products.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Opt-in is team-wide.</strong> Enabling Fable 5.1 requires opting in to Anthropic&#x27;s data retention terms, and this applies to your entire team. Enterprise admins can restrict which user groups are able to use the model with <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/enterprise/model-and-integration-management#model-access-control">model access control</a>.</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="automatic-fallback-to-opus"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#automatic-fallback-to-opus" data-heading-base-id="automatic-fallback-to-opus" aria-label="Copy link to automatic-fallback-to-opus"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Automatic fallback to Opus</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Fable 5.1 runs with tight security guardrails. When a request trips one of those guardrails, Cursor routes it to Claude Opus automatically so your work continues without an error. You don&#x27;t need to retry or switch models yourself.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="tools"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#tools" data-heading-base-id="tools" aria-label="Copy link to tools"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Tools</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Fable 5.1 has access to all agent tools when used with Cursor including:</p>

<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Fable 5.1 bills at $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens, the same as Fable 5. Prompt-cache reads are $0.25 per million tokens, 75% below Fable 5&#x27;s $1.00 cache-read rate. Cache writes stay at $12.50 per million tokens.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Fable 5.1 supports a thinking variant for deeper reasoning.
